resources.string: Discover the city closest to 5 PM. Choose a clear digital clock or a classic analogue face.
Choose how this widget looks on your home screen.
Style and seconds apply to this widget. Touch and hold it on the home screen to change them later.
A little reminder that it is almost five somewhere. Add the widget to your home screen; tap its clock to open the full app.
Leave blank to open settings instead. The website applies to all widgets. Saving here applies style and seconds to all widgets. Touch and hold a widget to customize it individually.
Enter an http:// or https:// URL with a valid hostname.
Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, then 5PM Clock.
No browser is available to open the clock.

The clocks tick locally without a background JavaScript process. Locations change automatically using idle-capable alarms, with a periodic recovery update. Android or Samsung battery restrictions can still delay delivery.
